text.p: Croatia had to settle for a 1-1 draw in a crucial World Cup qualifier against Denmark on Saturday after a strong wind diverted a Brian Laudrup cross into the top corner of the net with only eight minutes left.
The home team held the initiative for much of the game but failed to convert any of the good chances, especially in the first half, thanks mainly to Manchester United goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel.
But five minutes into the second half Croatia's top scorer Davor Suker did manage to tip the ball over Schmeichel after a cross by Robert Jarni from the left.
Laudrup's late equaliser got caught up in the strong wind and took Croatian goalkeeper Drazen Ladic by surprise.
Denmark have now drawn level with Greece at the top of group one on seven points but have played one game fewer. Croatia are in third, two points adrift.
